title: [Web] Building release templates on web fails with `threads=yes`
body:
### Tested versions

Regression from:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/122213

### System information

N/A

### Issue description

Building fails with:
```
wasm-ld: error: --shared-memory is disallowed by core/godot.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.wasm.lto.libcore.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.a(local_debugger.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.o at 18534354).o because it was not compiled with 'atomics' or 'bulk-memory' features.
wasm-ld: error: modules/godot.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.wasm.lto.libmodule_gdscript.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.a(gdscript_editor.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.o at 2283306).o: relocation R_WASM_MEMORY_ADDR_TLS_SLEB cannot be used against non-TLS symbol `ScriptDebugger::break_lang`
wasm-ld: error: modules/godot.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.wasm.lto.libmodule_gdscript.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.a(gdscript_editor.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.o at 2283306).o: relocation R_WASM_MEMORY_ADDR_TLS_SLEB cannot be used against `ScriptDebugger::break_lang` in non-TLS section: .bss
wasm-ld: error: modules/godot.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.wasm.lto.libmodule_gdscript.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.a(gdscript_editor.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.o at 2283306).o: relocation R_WASM_MEMORY_ADDR_TLS_SLEB cannot be used against non-TLS symbol `ScriptDebugger::break_lang`
wasm-ld: error: modules/godot.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.wasm.lto.libmodule_gdscript.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.a(gdscript_editor.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.o at 2283306).o: relocation R_WASM_MEMORY_ADDR_TLS_SLEB cannot be used against `ScriptDebugger::break_lang` in non-TLS section: .bss
wasm-ld: error: core/godot.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.wasm.lto.libcore.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.a(core_bind.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.o at 5153018).o: relocation R_WASM_MEMORY_ADDR_TLS_SLEB cannot be used against non-TLS symbol `ScriptDebugger::break_lang`
wasm-ld: error: core/godot.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.wasm.lto.libcore.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.a(core_bind.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.o at 5153018).o: relocation R_WASM_MEMORY_ADDR_TLS_SLEB cannot be used against `ScriptDebugger::break_lang` in non-TLS section: .bss
wasm-ld: error: core/godot.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.wasm.lto.libcore.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.a(script_language.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.o at 29830550).o: relocation R_WASM_MEMORY_ADDR_TLS_SLEB cannot be used against non-TLS symbol `ScriptDebugger::break_lang`
wasm-ld: error: core/godot.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.wasm.lto.libcore.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.a(script_language.web.template_release.wasm32.disable_3d.o at 29830550).o: relocation R_WASM_MEMORY_ADDR_TLS_SLEB cannot be used against `ScriptDebugger::break_lang` in non-TLS section: .bss
```

Probably related to code being built/included with some incorrect flags (this is a custom build with 3D disabled but happens in all release builds, with or without dlink support)

This is with emsdk `4.0.20`, seems to be fixed in `6.0.6`

### Steps to reproduce

Build web export templates with: `target=template_release dlink_enabled=No platform=web production=Yes threads=Yes`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
